title: Question 8
stem: Plutonium-238 (^{238}_{94}Pu) is unstable and undergoes alpha decay.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the equation to show the decay of plutonium-238.

$$^{238}_{94}\mathrm{Pu} \to {}^{\text{........}}_{\text{........}}\mathrm{U} + {}^{\text{........}}_{\text{........}}\alpha$$
hints: Hint 1: Focus on the physical mechanism in nuclear physics and radioactive decay that causes this behavior.
Hint 2: Rearrange the algebraic equation to isolate the target variable before substituting numerical values.
parts.proper_answer: 234, 92 for the uranium nucleus; 4, 2 for the alpha particle
walkthrough:
Step 1: **Identify Governing Principle**
State the core physical principle governing this problem: Nuclear physics and radioactive decay. Identify the relationship between the given quantities.

Step 2: **Apply Physics Criteria**
Explain the mechanism clearly using standard terminology:
234, 92 for the uranium nucleus; 4, 2 for the alpha particle

Step 3: **Units & Significant Figures**
State the final result clearly with appropriate significant figures (typically 2 or 3 s.f.) and standard SI units.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Calculate the initial number $N_{0}$ of nuclei of plutonium-238 in the power source.

$$N_{0} = \text{....................................................}$$
hints: Hint 1: Identify all given parameters and units, then recall the fundamental equation in A Level Physics theory and principles connecting them.
walkthrough:
Step 1: **Identify Governing Principle**
State the core physical principle governing this problem: A level physics theory and principles. Identify the relationship between the given quantities.

Step 2: **Substitute Values & Calculate**
Work through the substitution and calculation systematically:
N0 = 0.874 / (238 × 1.66 × 10-27) = 2.21 × 1024
Verify intermediate arithmetic carefully.

Step 3: **Units & Significant Figures**

parts.text:

Calculate the time, in years, for which the space probe will function.

$$\text{time} = \text{....................................................}\,\text{years}$$

Hint 2: Rearrange the algebraic equation to isolate the target variable before substituting numerical values.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
An alternative power source uses energy generated from the radioactive decay of polonium-210. This isotope has a half-life of $0.378\,\text{years}$. The mass of the isotope needed for the same initial power output as in (b) is $3.37\,\mathrm{g}$.
Suggest one advantage and one disadvantage of using polonium-210 as the source of energy.

markscheme_points.text: advantage: less mass so less energy needed to launch probe
disadvantage: half-life shorter so will not provide power for as long
